purpose: Build an affordable autonomous development system that advances Reality Loom and its Control Center without requiring repeated user prompts.

objectives.title: Restore unattended runner execution
acceptance: A scheduled or manually dispatched run obtains a runner
At least one job step executes
A report artifact or commit is produced
objectives.next: Inspect GitHub Actions settings and runner allocation failure; use an approved alternate runner if needed.

objectives.title: Establish reliable autonomous audit and test cycles
acceptance: Scout, research, and test agents execute in sequence
Failures are recorded and retried within a bounded budget

objectives.title: Deploy and verify the Control Center gateway
Add privacy-conscious traffic analytics
acceptance: Visitor metrics are visible in Control Center
No unnecessary personal data is collected

notes: Do not claim background execution until a real runner run is verified.
